is_anopheles.evidence: Mosquitoes studied include Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s.), An. funestus s.l., and An. nili (p. 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tested for the L1014F kdr mutation (Vgsc L995F) using PCR following Martinez-Torres et al. (p. 5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 9 states: 'Frequency of the L1014F kdr mutation in An. gambiae s.s. was 89.8% (95% CI: 88.2–91.2, n = 829) compared to 84.3% (95% CI:82.5–85.9, n = 968) in An. coluzzii collected during HLC.' Additional district-level allelic frequencies are referenced in S2 Table.

african_field_population.evidence: Field mosquitoes collected across 60 villages in Cove, Zangnanando, and Ouinhi districts, Zou region, southern Benin between September and October 2019 (p. 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary field study providing baseline entomological indicators before a cluster-randomized controlled trial (p. 1, 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Specifies 60 villages across Cove, Zangnanando, and Ouinhi districts in southern Benin, including coordinates (p. 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections took place between September and October 2019 (p. 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Baseline data for the New Nets Project RCT in Benin, representing original field collections in 2019 (p. 2, 3).

supplement.evidence: 'Supporting information files, S2 Table. Allelic frequencies of the L1014F kdr mutation in An. gambiae s.s and An. coluzzii collected using HLCs' contains the disaggregated district-level genotype/allele data (p. 9, 13).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated baseline entomological indicators and insecticide resistance in Cove, Zangnanando, and Ouinhi districts, Benin, in 2019 prior to an RCT. A total of 1,797 An. gambiae s.l. (829 An. gambiae s.s. and 968 An. coluzzii) collected via HLC were genotyped for the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) kdr mutation. WHO tube bioassays with alpha-cypermethrin, permethrin, bendiocarb, pirimiphos-methyl, and PBO synergist assays were also conducted on field-reared adults, but bioassay mosquitoes were not linked to individual genotypes.
